  Jose Osuna, Commissioner

Christina Pizarro Winting, Executive Director

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 9:08 AM, President Frost Hollins called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Garnica, Love, Osuna, Gordon-Peterson, Frost Hollins

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 Caprice McDonald, Employment Services Officer, led the Pledge of Allegiance.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 There was no public comment.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-53034  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the Charter Amendment Meet
  and Confer.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Garnica, seconded by Vice
  President Gordon-Peterson, that the item be laid over to the Civil Service
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, May 8, 2024. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Garnica, Love, Osuna, Gordon-Peterson, Frost Hollins
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Christina Pizarro Winting, Executive Director, spoke.
